verses.en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.pt: Cantai alegremente a Deus, nossa fortaleza; erguei alegres vozes ao Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to the Gittith. Of Asaph.> Make a song to God our strength: make a glad cry to the God of Jacob.

verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.pt: Entoai um salmo, e fazei soar o adufe, a suave harpa e o saltério.
verses.en_web: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
verses.en_bbe: Take up the melody, playing on an instrument of music, even on corded instruments.

verses.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.pt: Tocai a trombeta pela lua nova, pela lua cheia, no dia da nossa festa.
verses.en_web: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
verses.en_bbe: Let the horn be sounded in the time of the new moon, at the full moon, on our holy feast-day:

verses.en: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.pt: Pois isso é um estatuto para Israel, e uma ordenança do Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: For this is a rule for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.pt: Ordenou-o por decreto em José, quando saiu contra a terra do Egito. Ouvi uma voz que não conhecia, dizendo:
verses.en_web: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
verses.en_bbe: He gave it to Joseph as a witness, when he went out over the land of Egypt; then the words of a strange tongue were sounding in my ears.

verses.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.pt: Livrei da carga o seu ombro; as suas mãos ficaram livres dos cestos.
verses.en_web: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.en_bbe: I took the weight from his back; his hands were made free from the baskets.

verses.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.pt: Na angústia clamaste e te livrei; respondi-te no lugar oculto dos trovões; provei-te junto às águas de Meribá.
verses.en_web: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You gave a cry in your trouble, and I made you free; I gave you an answer in the secret place of the thunder; I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. (Selah.)

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.pt: Ouve-me, povo meu, e eu te admoestarei; ó Israel, se me escutasses!
verses.en_web: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O my people, and I will give you my word, O Israel, if you will only do as I say!

verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.pt: não haverá em ti deus estranho, nem te prostrarás ante um deus estrangeiro.
verses.en_web: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
verses.en_bbe: There is to be no strange god among you; you are not to give worship to any other god.

verses.en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito; abre bem a tua boca, e eu a encherei.
verses.en_web: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord your God, who took you up from the land of Egypt: let your mouth be open wide, so that I may give you food.

verses.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.pt: Mas o meu povo não ouviu a minha voz, e Israel não me quis.
verses.en_web: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
verses.en_bbe: But my people did not give ear to my voice; Israel would have nothing to do with me.

verses.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.pt: Pelo que eu os entreguei à obstinação dos seus corações, para que andassem segundo os seus próprios conselhos.
verses.en_web: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
verses.en_bbe: So I gave them up to the desires of their hearts; that they might go after their evil purposes.

verses.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.pt: Oxalá me escutasse o meu povo! oxalá Israel andasse nos meus caminhos!
verses.en_web: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.en_bbe: If only my people would give ear to me, walking in my ways!

verses.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.pt: Em breve eu abateria os seus inimigos, e voltaria a minha mão contra os seus adversários.
verses.en_web: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: I would quickly overcome their haters: my hand would be turned against those who make war on them.

verses.en: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.pt: Os que odeiam ao Senhor o adulariam, e a sorte deles seria eterna.
verses.en_web: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
verses.en_bbe: The haters of the Lord would be broken, and their destruction would be eternal.

verses.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.pt: E eu te sustentaria com o trigo mais fino; e com o mel saído da rocha eu te saciaria.
verses.en_web: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
verses.en_bbe: I would give them the best grain for food; you would be full of honey from the rock.
